description: This source file defines the SimpleMapProcessor class, which provides functionality for processing and executing simple map-based configurations defined in XML files, including loading map processors from XML resources or URLs, caching them, and executing them with input maps and locale considerations.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcessor
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing and executing simple map processors defined via XML, including loading processors from resources or URLs, caching, and running them with input maps.

methods.name: getAllProcessors
methods.description: Reads an XML document from a URL and parses it to create a map of processor names to MapProcessor instances.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves a map of processors from cache or loads them from an XML resource specified by resource path, classloader, and name.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves a map of processors from cache or loads them from a URL.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named map processor defined in an XML resource, with specified input and output maps, messages, locale, and classloader.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named map processor defined at a URL, with specified input and output maps, messages, locale, and classloader.
